terminus.finding: 郭貽菱's 2017 防跌工班 field notes show a practical contradiction: the group's identity initially appears tied to installing anti-fall fixtures, but a ready-made toilet assist rail can outperform custom installation. The text then explicitly asks whether the group's value is technical labor at all, or rather matching tools to people, relationship-building and exchange. A second case shows the same non-technical logic: repeated visits are needed because residents forget prior discussions or become anxious, so 'relationship work' becomes part of the intervention itself.
terminus.candidate: A recurring structure worth testing across unrelated materials: when a better tool solves the stated technical problem, it can expose that the real function of an organization/practice lies elsewhere—coordination, trust, interpretation, negotiation or exchange. Call this provisionally 'solution-induced identity exposure'.
terminus.quality: High observational density, named recorder and concrete cases; moderate conceptual polish; highly reusable as case/process ore. Keep attribution to 郭貽菱 rather than treating it as user-authored thought.
terminus.next: test this candidate against unrelated project/course/community materials where technical solutions either replace or fail to replace relational work
